title: Terminal
ownerOnly: Only the owner can open the terminal

targetsFailed: Could not load the machine list
targetMissing: This project is not ready on the selected machine

unlock.description: Enter your Crew sign-in password to open the terminal. Unlocking lasts 12 hours for this sign-in session.
